provenance.steps: Hand computation on present_values.csv: PVs in total per currency for EUR, USD and GBP; BASE and CONTRACT carry no layer, because BASE uses CPR_BASE in both layers and CONTRACT has SMM = 0 (M15), so both layers subtract the same PV_BASE. dEVE_s = PV_s - PV_BASE, negative a loss, for every scenario of each layer and currency, user shocks included. INTERNAL EUR: the worst of the six supervisory scenarios is PAR_UP, 950,000.0034 - 1,000,000.1234 = -50,000.12; CONTRACT (-99,999.6234) and USER_UP_300 (-80,000.1234) are lower but excluded; the largest absolute change is the gain PAR_DOWN +60,000.3333. STANDARDISED EUR: STEEPENER -60,000.1234, lower than every INTERNAL supervisory dEVE, so a worst case over both layers would differ. USD: PAR_DOWN -10,000 (INTERNAL) and -12,000 (STANDARDISED); adding EUR and USD by scenario would give an INTERNAL worst of -45,000.12. GBP has only the INTERNAL layer, no CONTRACT PV and only gains: the worst is SHORT_UP +100, never clamped to 0.
